tools.name: health-codes_fda-ndc-lookup
tools.description: Resolve a 10-digit or 11-digit NDC, or search a proprietary/non-proprietary name, in the vendored FDA NDC Directory subset of human prescription and OTC drugs. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/health-codes/fda-ndc-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: health-codes_fda-orange-book-lookup
tools.description: Return Orange Book product, therapeutic-equivalence, patent and exclusivity rows for an application number, trade name or ingredient from the vendored Orange Book data files. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/health-codes/fda-orange-book-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does no

tools.name: health-codes_fda-510k-lookup
tools.description: Find a 510(k) or De Novo decision by number, applicant, device name or product code in the vendored FDA 510(k) releasable database (1996–current). Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/health-codes/fda-510k-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: health-codes_fda-drug-enforcement-search
tools.description: Search vendored openFDA drug enforcement reports by recall number, firm, product text, classification or status. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/health-codes/fda-drug-enforcement-search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: health-codes_fda-drug-shortage-lookup
tools.description: Look up vendored openFDA drug-shortage entries by generic name, package NDC or company, with the snapshot date of the export. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/health-codes/fda-drug-shortage-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: health-codes_cqc-location-lookup
tools.description: Look up a CQC-registered care location in England from the vendored care directory and latest published Overall ratings by location id, name, postcode or provider id. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/health-codes/cqc-location-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "health-codes" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: health-codes_fda-ndc-lookup, health-codes_fda-drug-enforcement-search · Private data: health-codes_fda-orange-book-lookup, health-codes_fda-510k-lookup · Public sink: health-codes_fda-ndc-lookup, health-codes_fda-orange-book-lookup, health-codes_fda-510k-lookup, health-codes_fda-drug-enforcement-search, health-codes_fda-drug-shortage-lookup, health-codes_cqc-location-lookup · Destructive: health-codes_fda-ndc-lookup, health-codes_fda-orange-book-lookup, health-codes_fda-510k-lookup, health-codes_fda-drug-enforcement-search, health-codes_fda-drug-shortage-lookup, health-codes_cqc-location-lookup.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
